question: Welche Migrantengruppe hat, abgesehen von den in Deutschland Geborenen, bei Frauen im Alter von 30-40 eine Erwerbstätigenquote von etwa 60-70%?
question_english: Which migrant group, aside from those born in Germany, has an employment rate of approximately 60-70% for women aged 30-40?
model_answer: Based on the figure, the group of migrants who arrived in Germany since 2010 (blue line) exhibits an employment rate of roughly 60-70% for women aged 30-40. This is the highest employment rate observed among the migrant groups, excluding those born in Germany. The black line represents those without a migration background and the gray line those born in Germany.
